video_description: A group of people are seated around a long wooden table covered with a red and white checkered tablecloth.
One individual stands at the head of the table writing on a whiteboard mounted on the wall.
Several others are seated around the table, observing the whiteboard and engaging in conversation.
A clapperboard rests on the table near the foreground, along with a plastic water bottle.
The speaker <voice_467> addresses the group saying 'MAI: 喏，紫夏，然后对。LYS.'
Later, the speaker <voice_516> asks 'MAI: 这位是谁的？'
The speaker <voice_517> responds 'MAI: 我紫夏，或者写个L也行。'
The speaker <voice_518> continues the discussion asking 'MAI: 还有呢？你要你请两个。'
The speaker <voice_519> adds 'MAI: 对，但有一个可能来不了。'
Finally, the speaker <voice_520> clarifies 'MAI: 性别？', followed by 'MAI: 都是女的。'
high_level_conclusions: The speaker <voice_467> is leading a session involving name identification and attendance checks.
The speaker <voice_517> identifies herself as Zi Xia.
The speaker <voice_520> confirms that all participants in the group are female.
